root_cause_analysis: Self-referencing hash field was computed prior to embedding the field into the JSON file, causing file bytes SHA-256 to diverge from the embedded field value. Preflight guard in v1 did not compute digest.
supersession_decision: Preserve v1 historical file intact; supersede via JAYT_CONTAMINATION_FREEZE_STATE_V2.json employing deterministic non-self-referencing canonical payload hash contract.
